description: Add basic auth and cloud save/load using Supabase

tasks.title: Add Supabase client utility
tasks.description: Install Supabase JS and create a client wrapper with env detection.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json lists @supabase/supabase-js in dependencies
File src/lib/supabase.ts exports supabase client
File src/lib/supabase.ts exports isSupabaseConfigured boolean
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Installed @supabase/supabase-js and added supabase client with env detection.

tasks.title: Add auth session state to store
tasks.description: Track auth user/session in Zustand with setter/clearer actions and selectors.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/lib/store.ts includes authSession and authUser state
Store exports setAuthSession and clearAuthSession actions
Selectors export useAuthUser and useAuthSession
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Added authSession/authUser state, actions, and selectors in Zustand store.

tasks.title: Add AuthProvider session sync
tasks.description: Sync Supabase auth session into the store on app load and auth changes.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/AuthProvider.tsx exists
Provider calls supabase.auth.getSession on mount
Provider subscribes to supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange
File src/app/layout.tsx wraps children with AuthProvider
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Added AuthProvider to sync Supabase session and wired it in layout.

tasks.title: Create AuthModal UI
tasks.description: Add a modal for email/password sign in and sign up with Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/AuthModal.tsx exists
Modal supports sign-in and sign-up modes
Submit handlers call supabase.auth.signInWithPassword and signUp
Buttons use min-h-[44px] for touch targets
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - app loads
agent-browser: click Sign in - Auth modal visible
tasks.notes: Added AuthModal with sign-in/up flows and header Sign in trigger; verified modal opens.

tasks.title: Add account controls to Header
tasks.description: Show Sign in when logged out, user email + Sign out when logged in.
acceptanceCriteria: Header renders Sign in button when authUser is null
Header renders user email and Sign out when authUser exists
Sign out calls supabase.auth.signOut and clears store session
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - Sign in button visible
tasks.notes: Header now conditionally renders Sign in or user email + Sign out.

tasks.title: Implement Supabase save/load functions

acceptanceCriteria: File src/lib/projectPersistence.ts exports saveProject, listProjects, loadProject

Load returns parsed project data ready for hydration
Handles missing Supabase config by returning errors
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
